purpose: Cover AC-2501-1 through AC-2501-7 via unit tests over the shipped application-file-upload blueprint.json contribution shape (18 contributions in the 5 REQ / 7 US / 3 TAC / 3 ADR groups), the applies-clean pass on a fresh init project, the pack-loader accepting the shipped pack file with every check id cross-checked against blueprint AC ids and appliesTo referencing BOTH tacIds and route, the sample-app fixture serving both transport branches multipart POST and tus.io, the negative-run behaviour on the ?break=no-input ?break=no-live-region ?break=send-refused and ?break=no-chunks switches, the state-and-transport enumeration parity across README guide pack and docs/topics.md registry, and the README mechanism-reach gaps and CHANGELOG 1.0.0 entry.
title: application-file-upload v1.0.0 shelf shape, probe pack cross-check and sample-app fixture

testCases.description: blueprint.json declares slug, version 1.0.0, category application, 18 contributions in 5/7/3/3 groups; providesRoles absent; capabilities absent; requiresAppliedCapabilities absent; suggestedCompanions logging and errorHandling
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/application-file-upload-anatomy.test.js::blueprint.json declares 18 contributions with no capabilities and no requiresAppliedCapabilities (TC-054-blueprint-json-shape)

testCases.description: Fresh init project applies application-file-upload cleanly and reports the tree clean
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/application-file-upload-anatomy.test.js::applies cleanly on a fresh init project and adds 18 documents to the tree (TC-054-applies-clean)

testCases.description: Every pack check id matches a contributed AC id; pack-level appliesTo references BOTH tacIds and route; withUrl helper used for every URL string
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/application-file-upload-anatomy.test.js::every pack check id matches a contributed AC id and appliesTo binds tacIds AND route (TC-054-pack-checks-cross-check)

testCases.description: Sample-app fixture serves the multipart POST default and the tus.io elicited alternative honestly on their default branches and via ?transport= switch
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/application-file-upload-anatomy.test.js::sample-app fixture serves both transport branches on the default branch (TC-054-fixture-serves-transports)

testCases.description: Break switches surface the four defects on the DOM or network layer for the corresponding pack checks
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/application-file-upload-anatomy.test.js::sample-app fixture break switches surface the four defects on the DOM (TC-054-negative-runs)

testCases.description: Four state slugs and two transport slugs appear identically across README, guide, pack checks[] and docs/topics.md registry
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/application-file-upload-anatomy.test.js::four state slugs and two transport slugs appear identically across README guide pack and docs (TC-054-state-and-transport-parity)
